exceptions.rationale: SIP full-session probe (scripts/alpaca_sip_full_session_probe.py, Phase 1.6) proved this session's 5-minute intraday bars remain severely or meaningfully partial on the SIP feed (2/78 to 49/78 expected bars, 37-97% missing) even though the daily bar is complete. This mirrors the IEX-feed gap documented in reports/audit/data_source_decision_brief_20260716.md and is not resolved by a feed change alone.
exceptions.residual_impact_statement: Per reports/audit/sip_residual_impact_20260716.md: this date is not a monthly rebalance signal date and not a next-open execution date (category (c), all 4 known dates), and the ranking/selection engine (_relative_strength_daily_features via _daily_ohlcv_from_frame) is code-traced to depend exclusively on daily OHLCV with zero path through 130-min data -- so, with SIP providing complete daily coverage plus this exception, residual affected_rebalance_decision_count is 0 (down from 3,304/3,445 baselines). One secondary, non-decision-affecting nuance remains and is not softened: generate_relative_strength_rotation_signals (backtest/execution simulation only, a different function than the ranking engine) reindexes onto the 130-min timestamp index, so a full historical backtest spanning this date would silently skip same-day mark-to-market for every symbol on this date -- a simulation continuity artifact, not a trading decision.
